reviews.title: Easy to put together, comfortable, well priced chair!
reviews.body: This chair was a breeze to put together and is very comfortable to sit in. The instructions were very clear on the steps to get it together, as well as it had the tools and hardware you needed to get the job done. Parts fit where they were supposed to, and it took me all of 15 minutes to go from in the box to sitting in it in front of my desk. This was the easiest piece of furniture to put together I've ever done and I've done my fair share.The char is very comfortable to sit in as I said, and I love it already. My old chair broke and i was using a keyboard bench in front of my computer desk, which was ok, but it sucked not having a back to lean against. This chair feels good on my back and my cheeks. I love that the arms swivel up. so that if I'm making music or something that requires a lot of turning to the sides, etc, I can just lift them up and get them out of the way. The whole chair feels well made and sturdy, and it's rated to support up to 300lbs, so unless I really let myself go, it should last me for a good while lol.This chair is priced well and is a good buy in my opinion. The back doesn't lean back, but I prefer that. I want to be up, alert and focused on what I'm doing at my desk in my chair. I don't think I'll be falling asleep accidentally in this chair too quick, so to me it's a plus. It's still comfortable and exactly fit my needs. 5 stars all around!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 20 December 2025
reviews.author: DJ GodsOwn

reviews.title: Very nice chair at a reasonable price.
reviews.body: Packaging: The chair is well packaged. All the parts were in the box. All of the hardware is labeled including a small pack containing extra pieces of hardware just inn case they are needed. The allen wrench has a T handle and is a step up from what I typically see. The seat and back come covered in plastic.Assembly: Overall the assembly is easy. The steps are in logical order starting with attaching the spider legs (my term) being attached to the center piece. At step 4 of the assembly the instructions show putting a cosmetic cover piece that hides the bolts that attach the legs to the center piece. This cover was not in the box. I reached out to the seller & they promptly responded. The assembly instructions in the box was a first addition.  There is a second addition that illuminates that step because the cover is no longer needed. They sent me an electronic version of the correct assembly instructions. I did notice during assembly that there didn’t seem to be a need for the cover because they design looks finished without the cover.Appearance: When assembled the chair looks nice. The feel of the material is nice. The finish of the back and seat were good. There were no issues with poor seams or sloppy sewing lines. It looks like they have a good level of quality control in place.Comfort: The chair feels nice with good lumbar support. I feel like it fits like a glove. However, I’m only 5’6” tall. I wouldn’t expect a taller person to have that kind of fit. The lumbar support is not adjustable. The chair will adjust in height and the recline function can be locked out.Overall I would recommend this chair as a good, no frills chair that’s comfortable. Time will tell if there are durability issues.

reviews.title: A Game-Changer for Comfort and Efficiency
reviews.body: I am incredibly pleased with my black executive office chair purchase and have to highlight its superb qualities.Firstly, setting it up was a cinch. The instructions were so straightforward that assembling the chair was done in no time. Once it was ready, the comfort and support it provided exceeded expectations. The cushioning is just right, and the ergonomic design, particularly the lumbar support, makes long hours sitting much more bearable.Moreover, this chair is great for the budget. It delivers high-end luxury and comfort without draining your wallet. It certainly offers excellent value for the price.The black PU material isn't just sophisticated and professional, it's also remarkably resilient.All in all, this chair merges simplicity in assembly, top-notch comfort, value, a pleasing aesthetic, and durability into one impressive package. It's a necessary enhancement for any workspace.

reviews.title: Comfy computer chair
reviews.body: Bought this for my mother in law to replace the one she had for over 10 years. She loved it. The size was perfect, quality is great for such a budget friendly chair. Assembly was easy and very comfortable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable computer chair.

reviews.title: Excellent back support executive desk chair.
reviews.body: This is an exceptional price for this quality chair. It only took 30 minutes to put together. The directions are very explicit and easy to follow. There is only one tool needed to put the chair together, and they even supply it along with the bolts needed. I'm a woman in my sixties and I found it very easy to put together by myself. It looks beautiful and luxurious. I love that the seat raises to a full 23 inches. My last chair only went up 20 inches and it was not high enough for my desk. This is perfect!  Of course, the chair can rock back and forth as well. Another great feature is that when you are done working you can raise the armrests so that the chair can slide all the way into the desk saving lots of room. My other chair was giving me lower back pain. No pain at all in this chair. Well worth the investment. The only issue I had was that the right armrest had black scratches and staining on the silver structure area. The rest of the chair was perfect. So I emailed the company at their customer service email address. They responded very quickly and within just a few days sent me a brand new right arm piece unit at no charge that was in perfect condition. Excellent customer service. Very pleased. 5 stars.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 30 July 2023

features: Wide and Comfortable Seat Cushion - High-resilience PU foam provides exceptional comfort for working, gaming, or relaxing.
Ergonomic Design – Padded headrest, S-shaped backrest, and ergonomic lumbar support provide optimal comfort and help reduce back pain.
Premium PU Leather - Skin-friendly, waterproof, and easy to clean. This durable faux leather resists stains, scratches for long-lasting use.
Certified Quality - Heavy duty metal base and SGS-tested gas lift ensure durability and support up to 300 lbs. Inside the cushion, the support structure is made from FSC-certified wood.
